==Usage==
Use by simply placing <nowiki>{{user left}} or {{user left|your reason for leaving}}</nowiki> on your userpage. Providing a reason is optional.

This notice should only be used when permanently leaving Wookieepedia. For temporary absences, use {{Tl|Vacation}} instead. If you decide to return under this username, you may remove this template.
